Name: Lower Beth-horon
Description: The lower of the two Beth-horons, on Ephraim's border and the road down from the hills, built by Sherah daughter of Ephraim and later fortified by Solomon with walls, gates and bars.
BiblicalSignificance: Lower Beth-horon guarded the descent from the hill country to the coastal plain, a town built by a woman and fortified by a king.
